crossRefs.note: I have said beforehand, and I do say beforehand, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write…
For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority…
He spoke to the congregation, saying, “Depart, please, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs…
But Peter said, “Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and to keep back part of the price…
and said, “You son of the devil, full of all deceit and all cunning, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease…
Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season!” Immediately a…
What do you want? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?
For I most certainly, as being absent in body but present in spirit, have already, as though I were present, judged him…
of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I delivered to Satan, that they might be taught not to blaspheme.
Therefore if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not…
For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.
His affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembers all of your obedience, how with fear and trembling you…

translations.web: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience is made full.
translations.bsb: And we will be ready to punish every act of disobedience, as soon as your obedience is complete.
translations.kjv: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.
translations.asv: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience, when your obedience shall be made full.
